when: A person opens detail or changes window width.
action: Keep the selected object's stable ID and reconstruct the destination from it. The previous list keeps its filter.
verify: Open a filtered item, resize, close it and inspect selection and focus.

when: A transient surface closes after changing its source list.
action: Focus the initiating element if it still exists. Otherwise choose the nearest surviving action that explains the new state.
verify: Remove the last saved item inside its dialog, dismiss and activate the focused control.

when: A bounded editor has both Save and Cancel.
action: Edit a separate draft and commit by stable ID only after validation succeeds. Ask before abandoning meaningful dirty work.
verify: Edit, press Escape, keep editing, then discard. The committed object must match its previous version.

when: Submission fails or conflicts.
action: Identify the specific cause, keep valid values, associate the message with its field and focus the first repairable input when appropriate.
verify: Submit an overlapping booking and change only its start time before retry.

when: A cancellable operation may resolve after a newer one.
action: Assign the operation an identity. Apply its completion only while it is current. Disable duplicate submissions and model server-side effects separately.
verify: Cancel job A, complete B and deliver A's late result. Only B may change visible state.

when: A status claims content has been saved.
action: Report durability after storage acknowledges the write. If storage is unavailable, retain the draft for this visit and say where it lives.
verify: Deny storage writes, edit, close and reopen during the same visit. Read the status.

when: A list has zero results.
action: Distinguish a new collection from a filtered-out dataset. Offer one action that addresses the actual reason.
verify: Check both an empty saved shelf and a search term with zero results.

when: An action removes an object.
action: Prefer recoverable removal where appropriate. Name the affected object and restore its ID, order and keyboard focus after undo.
verify: Remove the middle item and undo it. Inspect the original neighbors and the restored action.

when: The app cannot calculate completion percentage.
action: Use an indeterminate progress role and a named pending action. Announce success, failure or cancellation exactly when it happens.
verify: Interrupt the printer and verify no success message or queued job appears.

rule: Express exact values independently of a chart
when: A chart reports measurements.
action: Use the same numeric model for axes, textual readings, accessible alternatives and saved observations. Convert units only for display.
verify: Select a time, change units and compare the readout with the hourly table.

when: Movement conveys a changed selection, context or region.
action: Preserve the final state and accessible label when motion is reduced. Retarget interrupted transitions.
verify: Enable reduced motion, reverse the selection rapidly and inspect the final label and geometry.

when: Details are collapsed in place.
action: Update expanded state on activation and remove hidden descendants from keyboard interaction. Return focus if code collapses a focused descendant.
verify: Open, focus inside, then collapse programmatically and Tab forward.

when: Width is compact or text is enlarged.
action: Let the grid track and its children shrink, let long text wrap, and keep labels visible. Use logical edges.
verify: Set 200% text, 390 px width and a long Arabic proof. Check document width and control reach.

when: A surface asks someone to choose or act.
action: Use a native button for commands, checkbox or switch for persistent Boolean state and a labeled radio group for mutually exclusive form values.
verify: Navigate by keyboard and inspect the role, label, value and disabled state.

rule: Make precision available without a drag
when: Someone adjusts a numeric value.
action: Bind the slider and discrete alternative to one value. Expose the unit, range and current value.
verify: Adjust by drag and stepper, then reset with Reduce Motion enabled.

when: A floating control overlaps visually varied content.
action: Use native material where appropriate, preserve contrast across the underlying image and provide an opaque fallback.
verify: Move the control across the brightest region and inspect both appearances and transparency settings.

when: A control accepts input or a validation error refers to it.
action: Use a persistent visible label and an accessible name. Put specific error text next to the field and associate it programmatically.
verify: Focus the field before and after an error. Inspect its name, invalid state and description.

when: A familiar task moves to a different device.
action: Adapt navigation and target spacing to remote focus, Crown input or spatial selection. Verify on the supported device class.
verify: Walk the critical path using only the intended input. Note which hardware checks remain open.

when: A requested feature needs restricted data.
action: Explain the purpose at first use and preserve a concrete alternative when access is denied.
verify: Decline permission and complete the permitted portion of the task.

when: The screen is a collection, workspace or instrument.
action: Choose a visual treatment that helps the user identify, compare or edit the actual product object.
verify: Name the first visible object, action and completion signal at compact and wide sizes.
